title: maja-box-closed
description: Dokładnie ten sam magazyn sceniczny i ta sama ogromna skrzynia na kompost co w shocie maja-box, ale wszystkie cztery górne klapy są całkowicie złożone i zamknięte. Maia oraz pełny stół DJ-ski z dwoma gramofonami i mikserem są ukryte w środku; z zewnątrz niczego ani nikogo nie widać.

prompts.image: Use maja-box as exact visual continuity. Preserve the identical camera, stage-storage room, lighting, crate dimensions, position, battered cardboard and green leaf symbol. Close all four top flaps completely and remove Maia from view. The crate remains large enough to conceal Maia and a full DJ console. Change nothing else; no chairs, audience, ceremony, stage, jury table, projection screen, visible equipment, text or watermark.
prompts.animation: Static locked camera for the entire shot. The huge closed cardboard compost crate begins completely still. After a brief quiet pause, a faint irregular movement comes from inside: one corner shifts by a few millimetres, the cardboard walls flex subtly, then the crate gives two short internal bumps that become slightly stronger toward the end. The motion must feel as if a person and heavy DJ equipment are cramped inside, preparing to burst out, but the crate never opens in this shot. All four top flaps remain fully folded shut, the green leaf symbol stays visible and unchanged, and nothing inside is revealed. Preserve the exact crate size, position, battered texture, room, doorway, lamp, walls, floor, lighting and composition.
